recovery_runs.stopping_reason: explicit stop: first-error path ignores LATENT_ONLY_FILE and scans unrelated files; retry missing payloads only with scratch file-selection filter

method.selection: Identical (file,unit) selection as four-way census: latest full observation wins, otherwise first-error. Only phase=lowering findings of selected stopped units. Per-file refusal_scan findings do not stop unit lowering and are excluded.
method.order: Preserved emission order within the selected unit; first stop is first non-Boundary finding, not earliest source line. Overall behind counts include later marked Boundary context; causal behind counts exclude Boundary entries.
method.deduplication: Use each original latent stream as emitted; recovery uses the same all-fields exact deduplication as latentFullSelected. Repeat dependency failures across different owner units remain separate observations. Distinct sites deduplicate actual finding where, not unit fallback.
method.classification: Explicit record/dictionary reasons or verified source index-signature object operations/literals. Generic reasons are classified occurrence by occurrence. A matching source read/write is context, not proof records are the only missing compiler feature. Primitive, array, tuple and Map/Set operations alone are excluded. Boundary groups are classified from source context and included in overall finding totals, but excluded from causal totals and first-stop ordering.
method.coverage: All 3666 selected stopped units have finding payloads. This is findings coverage, not completed compiler lowering; rollback, skipped/deferred units and interrupted candidate traversal gaps remain. No census counts are replaced.
